title: Gemini Tasks India me free: kaise on karein + 3 examples
description:
Gemini Tasks India me free kaise use karein? Google ne 17 November 2026 ko Tasks in Gemini launch kiya: Gemini ab sirf jawab nahi deta, poora kaam background me karta hai. India samet 6 deshon me bina subscription ke free. Is video me: Tasks kya hai, kise milega, on kaise karein (Task par tap), 3 poore examples (inbox saaf + to-do list, roz subah ki briefing schedule, research karke PDF), safety, US-only features, limits (ek saath 15 tasks) aur band kaise karein.

Chapters:
0:00 Gemini ab kaam bhi karega
0:22 Tasks kya hai (Chat vs Task)
1:10 Kise milega: 6 desh free, 3 shartein
1:55 On kaise karein: 4 steps
2:29 Example 1: inbox saaf + to-do list
3:00 Example 2: roz subah ki briefing (schedule)
3:28 Example 3: research karke PDF
4:00 Safety: isolated machine, filters, confirmation
4:38 Abhi sirf US me: calls, Google Pay, text, email
5:06 Limits: 15 tasks ek saath
5:37 Tasks band kaise karein
5:58 Recap
